description: This file is a PHP class definition for the Cart model in the Opencart e-commerce platform, specifically within the Checkout namespace. It contains methods for retrieving products, vouchers, and totals from the shopping cart, along with internal logic for managing cart-related data.

classes.name: Cart
classes.description: Model class managing shopping cart operations such as retrieving products, vouchers, and totals in the checkout process.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves detailed product information from the cart, including images, options, and pricing.

methods.name: getVouchers
methods.description: Returns an array of vouchers stored in the session data.

methods.name: getTotals
methods.description: Calculates and populates totals, taxes, and the final total amounts by loading appropriate extension models and applying sort orders.
